title: Experts disagree on runtime/claude-plugin/skills
context:
Chief architect: The three claims are one decision plus two proofs of it. The layout (generated folders committed beside onboard, join and dashboard, served by the existing skills path) is the lead; the drift proof with a deliberate edit and the exact 14-plus-3 count check (no paqad-* folder, no name clash with start) both stay as acceptance tests.

Target: runtime/claude-plugin/skills
- application-architect: the 14 generated discovery skill folders are committed here beside onboard, join and dashboard, so the existing skills path in .claude-plugin/plugin.json (./runtime/claude-plugin/skills) serves them with no new plugin layout and no dist-plugin/ tree
- qa-engineer: Given the committed tree, when node scripts/build-discovery.mjs runs, then git diff --exit-code and the untracked-files check are clean; a hand edit to a generated discovery skill must make the drift check fail (prove once with a deliberate edit).
- qa-engineer: Count check: exactly 14 discovery skill folders under the new unprefixed names plus onboard, join and dashboard; no folder still named paqad-* and no skill name collision with start.
